exact_blockers.unblock_procedure: Run tools/rq1b_five_run_driver.py --runs 5 with OSM_FILE pinned to campaigns/ingolstadt_cooked_perception_v1/source/ingolstadt_authoritative.osm and network access disabled.

exact_blockers.detail: tools/tile_frame_consistency.py derives placement from the bbox centroid of each tile's own building geometry and compares those centroids. That measures building-distribution asymmetry between neighbouring 1000 m cells, not world displacement. The 27/31 'FAIL' seams (max 485.84 m) are not evidence of misplacement. A control-anchor metric (OSM node ids / XODR road geometry) is required. The governed 10 m threshold was NOT changed.
exact_blockers.unblock_procedure: Regenerate the governed tile release retaining per-tile OSM XML, then match named OSM node anchors through source -> canonical -> rebase -> tile-local -> FBX -> package -> expected CARLA world.
